'''Trinthan prowlers''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Trinith system/Legends|Trinith system]]. After their discovery, these deadly cat-like creatures were sold across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for use as trained hunters and trackers. Due to their savage behavior and given some incidents where bystanders were badly mauled, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] made prowler [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] illegal and almost all the creatures were released into the wild. They could be found on a great many [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Quesh]], where their predatory skills allowed them to hunt smaller and slower creatures and, sometimes, also to attack sentients who were unlucky enough to find themselves near one of these beasts. The spleen of individuals found on Quesh was specialized to filter radioactive materials from their bloodstream, and, for unknown reasons, was extremely similar to the spleen of a [[Geo Beast]] native to [[Oricon]].<ref name="Calibrations">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Good Calibrations|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>
